The *Paṭhamasatta Sutta* (Ud 7.3, PTS Ud 75) is a short canonical discourse located in the seventh chapter of the *Udāna* [SuttaCentral]. The core teaching of the sutta addresses the danger of attachment to sensual pleasures, illustrating how such attachment prevents one from crossing over the flood [SuttaCentral]. Within later exegetical and paracanonical literature, the sutta is cited or referenced in the *Peṭakopadesa* (Pe 1 and Pe 2) [SuttaCentral].
